4 × 200 MM MOTION TOWERS / 1 EDGE HUBExplore the product ↓

Highlights.

01 / SENSOR

One camera
in each direction.

Each E3 tower has one Basler monochrome camera candidate. Two dark exterior windows remain reserved and inactive.

02 / 200 MM

Small enough
to define the play zone.

Each tower is fixed at no more than 200 mm in use. The three visible body sections are a surface treatment, not a telescoping mechanism.

03 / FOOTPRINT

Four feet.
A measured boundary.

The proposal uses a 96 mm base and a 200 mm contact circle. Cable pull, sliding, and tip resistance still require physical testing.

04 / EDGE HUB

Four viewpoints.
One local game loop.

The separate Hub is the integration point for RockstarOS, local compute, storage, push-to-talk audio, and four USB 3 camera streams.

TOWER20 E3 / FIXED HEIGHT

Motion Tower

200 mm.
One clear role.

A fixed-height aluminum tower acts as an input device. Its visible body sections keep the product rhythm without adding a motorized extension mechanism.

4 TOWER20 INPUT DEVICES + 1 SEPARATE EDGE HUB / CONCEPT RENDERING

01 / MONOCHROME GLOBAL SHUTTER

Four directions.
One shared coordinate system.

One camera candidate in each tower captures motion. The Hub must verify device identity, timing evidence, calibration revision, and tracking quality before an action can be committed.

PRIMARY / CANDIDATEBasler daA1600-60um

1600 × 1200 mono8. A 1280 × 800, 60 fps center ROI is the current planning profile, subject to real-device validation.

RESERVED / INACTIVETwo dark exterior windows

They preserve the product face but do not represent two additional working cameras in E3.

CYAN LIGHT IS A VISUAL STATUS EFFECT, NOT MEASURED SENSOR OUTPUT

02 / FIXED PRODUCT ENVELOPE

No extension.
No hidden scale change.

The proposed assembled height is 199.50 ± 0.45 mm. The 199.95 mm arithmetic maximum leaves only 0.05 mm, so measurement method and production margin remain open.

HEIGHT ≤ 200 MM / Ø44 MM BODY / NON-TELESCOPING E3

03 / FOUR-FOOT SUPPORT

Low profile.
Physical limits exposed.

The proposed 96 mm base uses four feet on a 200 mm contact circle. Low cable routing improves the tip model, while floor friction and a 5 N pull remain unresolved physical tests.

TIP, SLIDE, HEAT, AND CABLE-STRAIN ACCEPTANCE: NOT RUN

04 / EDGE HUB + ROCKSTAROS

Four data streams.
One local experience.

The separate low Hub is the only game, voice, storage, and AI compute node. It combines the four camera streams, a local game loop, push-to-talk Japanese voice, saved work, and approved adapters.

the space.

E3 replaces the former single-box E1 and E2 form with four 200 mm input towers and a separate low Edge Hub. Every number below is a design proposal or planning target, not measured production performance.

Physical capture cutoff and separate consent remain required. Releasing a switch does not grant consent.

AI350

Board, cooling, 160 W-class power budget, USB topology, drivers, and production selection remain unapproved.

Known E3 gaps remain visible: full-frame 30 fps misses the latency target, full-frame 60 fps exceeds the provisional shared USB budget, a 5 N pull can exceed the current tip or slide model, 4 W tower cooling is not closed, and the low camera geometry does not prove full-body or full-room coverage.
